description: C3.1 reproducible baseline plus requirement-traced functional coverage closure traffic.

source_inventory.c3_2_gpio_closure: Observed-handshake coverage for all 16 WSTRB patterns across six legal writable registers, AW/W gap classes, response backpressure, commit/snapshot latency, reset, W1C collision, MASK/IRQ, and GPIO DUT occupancy.

report_notes: C3.2 adds requirement-traced bins sampled from passive handshakes, real C2 commit/read-snapshot events, reset edges, observed GPIO pins, and response completion; sequence intent alone is not sampled.
The C3.2 closure row uses seed 21 and keeps non-zero WDATA when WSTRB=0000 so preservation is checked rather than sidestepped.
Controlled-slave depth/order and lifecycle/reset covergroups remain separate evidence and are not reported as GPIO DUT RTL coverage.
MASK=1 is characterized as enable to match current RTL, scoreboard, and SVA; SPEC-MASK-001 remains open because the original prose says mask.
C3.3 parameter/bad-slave expansion and C3.4 sign-off are outside this plan. Functional coverage percentage alone is not specification sign-off.

runs.execution_target: GPIO DUT RTL with read-only timing adapter
